page.overview:
Who is Abu Suliman?

Abu Suliman is a Ugandan jeweller, smuggler and Secret Intelligence Service operative who appeared in the 2015 video-game James Bond: World of Espionage.

Working his way into a United Nations post at an early age, Abu has made friends across the world. Charismatic and practical, his economic skills are sometimes used to funnel money in and out of difficult places, or to trace others attempts to do the same. Noted for being corrupt, he keeps a little in his own pockets. Introduced in the storyline Diamonds are Forever, Suliman is a jeweller (and MI6 informant) whom James Bond passes his illicit winnings onto.

Noted for being corrupt, he is skilled in smuggling, finance and deception, and is multi-lingual, speaking Arabic, Swahili, English and Malayalam. The character offers a chance to gain +500 bonus money from missions and provides a 1% chance to avoid damage using pen-knives, and a 5% chance to avoid using stamina on a Finishing Move using trilby hats. He is a 'common agent' (white) and can be levelled to level 5.
